policy.vod: PASS requires list, search, detail, direct media, >=67% media success, >=50% HD evidence, API median <=3000ms and media median <=4000ms.
policy.live: PASS requires >=8 channels, >=67% sampled media success, >=50% HD evidence, playlist <=3000ms and media median <=4000ms. Source-internal duplicate rate is reported, not rewritten or used to reject the upstream list.
policy.counting: VOD physical hosts and live playlist host+path are counted once; mirrors are not extra sources.
